title: Disabled buttons report as enabled to screen readers (AT-SPI state not updated)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable, 4.5.stable (the version that introduced screen reader support). Not tested in versions in between.

### System information

Ubuntu 26.04 - Godot v4.7.2.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS (16 threads)

### Issue description

Disabled buttons are exposed to AT-SPI with the same state as enabled buttons. A screen reader user tabbing onto a disabled button hears it announced as a normal, usable button.

`GetState` on an enabled and a disabled button in the same scene returns the identical bitmask:

```
au 2 1124075776 0   # enabled
au 2 1124075776 0   # disabled
```

Decodes to `ENABLED | FOCUSABLE | SENSITIVE | SHOWING | VISIBLE` for both. Same result whether `disabled` is set in the scene file or at runtime via GDScript, and same result on both 4.5.stable and 4.7.2.stable.

Labels do get a different state (no `FOCUSABLE`), so the bridge isn't ignoring node state in general, it just isn't propagating `Button.disabled`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the attached project (MRP incoming as a follow-up comment).
2. Tab to "Enabled Button", then "Disabled Button" with a screen reader running.
3. Both announce the same way.

To inspect the state directly without a screen reader:

```bash
AT_SPI_ADDR=$(busctl --user call org.a11y.Bus /org/a11y/bus org.a11y.Bus GetAddress | cut -d'"' -f2)
busctl --address="$AT_SPI_ADDR" list | grep -i godot
busctl --address="$AT_SPI_ADDR" call <conn> <button-path> org.a11y.atspi.Accessible GetState
```

### Minimal reproduction project

3 files, no script, `.godot/` excluded. Attaching as a follow-up comment since `gh` can't upload zip archives directly. Scene contents:

```
[gd_scene load_steps=1 format=3]

[node name="Main" type="Control"]
layout_mode = 3
anchors_preset = 15
anchor_right = 1.0
anchor_bottom = 1.0

[node name="Buttons" type="VBoxContainer" parent="."]
layout_mode = 1
anchors_preset = 8
anchor_left = 0.5
anchor_top = 0.5
anchor_right = 0.5
anchor_bottom = 0.5
grow_horizontal = 2
grow_vertical = 2

[node name="EnabledButton" type="Button" parent="Buttons"]
custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 48)
layout_mode = 2
text = "Enabled Button"

[node name="DisabledButton" type="Button" parent="Buttons"]
custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 48)
layout_mode = 2
disabled = true
text = "Disabled Button"
```
